# foreman_model (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_model" "poweredge_r640" {
  name = "PowerEdge R640"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the model to look up.

### Read-Only

- `hardware_model` (String)
- `hosts_count` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `info` (String)
- `vendor_class` (String)
